title: Repair bounded DOM persistence of validated syntax
api_or_output: Internal fresh-builder trusted syntax-validated node/member persistence; unchanged public API and validating general tree operations

acceptance.description: Provide explicitly documented internal trusted syntax-prevalidated node/attribute/namespace persistence on the verified fresh construction builder, avoiding unbounded repeated scalar/name/delimiter validation loops. Preserve freshness/owner/container/legal kinds, root constraints, intern quota/capacity, precommit version checks and postcommit notifications. Existing public validating APIs and builder checked entry points remain unchanged; no parser dependency or public additions.

Demonstrate independently validated syntax/model construction with long text, CDATA/comment/PI, names, attribute and namespace values; own strings and repeated borrowed name hits correctly. Verify state/freshness/foreign owner/legal kind/version/quota rejection and linear deep/member work; prove no repeated custom scalar validation scan. Keep cancellation at operation boundaries, avoiding unbounded own loops.

Run meaningful helper/prerequisite correctness, actual approved public API comparison, independent source and isolated package model sample, warm/setup/owned allocation evidence and applicable comparable construction measurements at known revisions; preserve earlier behavior and record exact trust preconditions/signatures for DOM consumer. Benchmarks use class attributes; no job arguments or timing without exclusive grant.

handoff.summary: Repair prerequisite for independently reviewed DOM persistence cancellation gap; trusted boundary may consume only fully validated syntax names/scalars/delimiters/unique keys.
